original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: For G=D8 and reflection labels {s,t}, determine whether the target diag([r],[r^-1],1), r=st of order four, can be realized on three arbitrary dirty scalar roles by at most three paid factors F_g(N)=I+([g]+1)N with all rank-one idempotents N in M3(F2).
scope_change_reason: This fixes a nonabelian group-algebra operation family outside the abelian three-register model and narrows the question to one distinct noncentral inverse-pair endpoint. The neighboring three-role D8 result is for the central endpoint diag([z],[z],[1]); the two-role inverse-pair result has a different role count.
bottleneck_link: A three-call word would save one of four paid rank-one calls in the formal block. The completed exact minimum is four, so this specific third-role mechanism does not reduce the direct paid bill. Physical hosting and recursive costs are outside the abstraction; no supplier admission or kappa change follows.
stop_rule: Use regular-representation displacement rank to exclude lengths zero through two. Enumerate every ordered length-three word over the 56-generator alphabet and stop after exact independent replay, direct length-four control, and endpoint/call negative controls.
evidence: The exact full-coefficient census checks all 56^3=175616 length-three words and finds zero hits. The 24-dimensional regular representation gives target displacement rank 12 and each paid factor displacement rank 4, excluding lengths at most two. The explicit four-call word reaches the endpoint and is independently replayed; hence the minimum in the named formal model is exactly four.
